one_liner: Klaviyo has a broad REST API with private API keys and OAuth, free-tier self-serve access, and an official remote MCP server.
auth_notes: Private API keys (scoped) for /api endpoints; OAuth authorization code flow with PKCE for apps; public key (site ID) for client endpoints. OAuth app creation is self-serve at klaviyo.com/oauth/client, though the App Marketplace listing requires partner approval.
access_notes: Free test account; no platform or API usage fees. Free tier covers 250 profiles. The Conversations API is gated and needs approval, but the core API is open.
blocker_notes: Only the Conversations API is gated. The webhooks API may need a waitlist.

evidence.quote: Klaviyo provides 3 methods of authentication including private key authentication and OAuth (used to call server-side APIs) and public key authentication (used to call client-side APIs).
